data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 40–41):** Jab jumle mein Ma'rifah ism (Jaise `اللَّهُ`) ke baad Tanween wala Nakirah lafz (`سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ`) aata hai toh us Tanween se **'hai'** (*Khabar*) ka mafhoom paida hota hai aur mukammal jumla ban jata hai: `وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ` (Aur Allah sunne wala, jaanne wala hai).
